source: GoatCounter /api/v0/stats/* (hourly totals) plus the export API. JSON export hit_stats give true per-Melbourne-hour page and referrer counts. CSV export (start_from_hit_id) would give true per-hour countries, browsers, OS and screen sizes, but only if Individual pageviews is enabled in GoatCounter settings; that table is currently empty, so those dimensions stay per Melbourne day. Published files contain aggregated counts only: no IPs, sessions, raw user agents or per-hit rows.
